facts.fact: The document says that in January 2021, just before the general election, the government ordered a block on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, WhatsApp and other social media and messaging apps, followed by a complete internet blackout; all platforms except Facebook were reopened when service returned days later.
facts.system: 2021 election internet blackout and social media block

facts.fact: The document says Facebook remained officially restricted in Uganda as of 2024, though many users reach it through VPNs.

note: The December 2025 signal of possible social media restrictions is a warning, not a cut, so no fact for it.
